name: Steve Taggers
summary:
Overview
Steve Taggers is a fan game of an app called "Gorilla Tag". This game is heavily inspired from Another Axiom/Gorilla Tag. This game is a chill experience. More updates will be out soon such as Multiplayer.

Gameplay
Move around with your arms/hands. This game is physics based. Play by your self and have fun in this unique fan game called Steve Taggers!!! By Roxy
